limits: The main grapes together: at least 80%
Carmenère and Petit Verdot, each: at most 10%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation on the Right Bank of the Gironde estuary, making red wine only. It is based mostly on Merlot, with Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon. Canon Fronsac lies entirely inside it.
